name: Malik
self_text: Hey there! I'm Malik, a late‑20s guy from Turkey studying economics. Right now I'm deep into statistics and love a step‑by‑step walkthrough session to really get the concepts. I get the most out of discussing things as we go – talking it through helps me explain ideas clearly. I’m happy to meet in person or online, whatever works best. Most weeks I’m free on Saturday afternoons or Sunday afternoons. Outside of stats, I enjoy sketching buildings in my free time. Looking forward to connecting with someone who shares a curiosity for learning and a relaxed vibe!

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who has things explained by me, and I need you to be into statistics. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with talking things through as we go, though it's not a requirement.
